apps.title: Dark Halloween Color by Number
apps.summary:
✨ Step Into the Magic, Color Your Spooky Halloween Sanctuary 🎃

Step into a haunted world where night comes alive, glowing jack-o'-lanterns light the path, and magic is waiting at your fingertips. Welcome to Dark Halloween Color by Number, your spooky escape into the cozy charm of enchanted autumn nights. This is more than just a coloring book; it is your personal time machine into a fantasy realm filled with spellbinding witches, mysterious vampires, and cute magical pets ready for your color by number creativity.

Whether you want to relax after a long day, dive into fun coloring games, or explore rich drawing pages, this color by number sanctuary is designed to soothe your mind and spark your dark imagination. Grab a cup of warm spiced cider, light a scented candle, listen to the whispering wind outside, and bring your favorite coloring pages to life with gentle art strokes.

🌟 Discover Spooky Themes & Enchanted Tales
Our hand-drawn gallery of art is meticulously curated to touch your soul and evoke the magical charm of the spooky season. Every single canvas in our coloring book offers a unique story waiting within your color by number journey:

Character: Meet charming autumn ghosts, mysterious midnight travelers, Trick-or-Treaters in detailed costumes, and sweet pumpkin fairies. Experience incredible drawing designs made for lovers of dark aesthetic art, perfect for your quiet coloring pages session.

Witch: Step into mystical potion rooms, brew sparkling cauldrons under the full moon, and explore flying broomsticks with glowing spell books in these rich coloring pages ideal for color by number fans.

Animal: Color adorable black cats perched on pumpkins, cute velvet bats wearing tiny hats, fluffy owls guarding ancient spellbooks, and glowing phantom puppies in our engaging coloring games packed with original art.

Vampire: Unveil the elegant world of gothic castles, royal velvet capes, moonlit balconies, and timeless vampire aristocrats waiting for your color by number magic to transform every drawing sketch.

🎨 Experience the Art of Mindful Relaxation

Gentle Rhythms: Feel the daily stress melt away as you tap to fill each section. Watch your canvas transform from quiet lines into a glowing masterpiece of autumn art. It is a peaceful, slow paint by number practice that grounds your thoughts.

Creative Flow: Forget the noise of the day and lose yourself in rich crimson reds, deep midnight purples, and warm glowing pumpkin oranges. Enjoy these immersive coloring games that bring static drawing creations to vivid art life.

Satisfying Progression: Experience the quiet thrill of watching a blank gothic sketch evolve into a vivid, glowing fantasy—one color at a time. Completing these coloring pages brings a deep sense of accomplishment to every paint by number enthusiast.

Personal Gallery: Save your favorite paint by number masterpieces into your private collection. Revisit your finished art, enjoy your creative journey, and share your stunning color by number creations with friends.

🌈 Why You’ll Love Dark Halloween Color by Number

Spooky & Cozy Aesthetics: Designed specifically for fans of Halloween, dark fantasy, and cozy autumn vibes. Every coloring book page honors the magical charm of the spooky season and inspires endless art exploration.

Endless Inspiration: New high-quality art and fresh drawing templates are added regularly, ensuring you always have new coloring pages waiting for your touch in our lively coloring games.

Stress-Free Experience: Enjoy a smooth, user-friendly paint by number interface. No complicated menus or timers—just you, soothing colors, and your favorite color by number world.

Take a deep breath, let go of the noise, and start your artistic journey today. Download Dark Halloween Color by Number, dive into magical coloring games, unlock countless drawing templates, and let the colors tell your spooky story!

apps.title: Astro Merge

Aim and release planets into the gravity field, then bring matching planets together to create larger worlds. Each successful merge opens more space, increases your score, and brings you closer to forming the biggest planets in the universe.

Features

• Launch planets into a dynamic gravity field
• Match identical planets to create larger worlds
• Plan around collisions, movement, and limited space
• Chain merges together to build your combo
• Discover colourful planets with unique designs
• Challenge yourself to achieve a new high score
• Enjoy simple controls and satisfying merge gameplay

How large can your universe become? Take aim, combine the planets, and reach for a new record in Astro Merge.

apps.title: Drone Strike: Gunship War
apps.summary:
Engage in Realistic Aerial Combat Warfare
• Command next-generation military drones and the iconic AC-130 Gunship in this modern shooter experience.
• Dominate the skies with explosive firefights, defending allies and delivering devastating airstrikes.
• Use precision flight paths, targeting systems, and weapon calibration to simulate true drone operations.
• Explore immersive 3D battlefields designed with realistic physics and advanced drone controls.

• Step into the role of a high-tech air force marksman with access to powerful weapon systems.
• Take down enemy squads in fast-paced aerial encounters with accuracy and skill.
• Unleash 25mm Gatling gun fire, Hydra 70 rockets, and Hellfire missiles to crush hostile forces.

• Unlock gear such as signal jammers, auto-tracking turrets, and enhanced navigation.

• Combine air and ground tactics to overwhelm the enemy on multiple fronts.
• Use SuperWeapons like EMP drones, cluster missile barrages, and drone swarms.

Face Varied Enemy Threats
• Battle against:
– Infantry squads, RPG teams, and fortified gun nests
– Armored convoys and heavy vehicles
– Attack helicopters, jets, and hostile drones
– Enemy bases and strategic installations
• Adaptive AI ensures every encounter requires fresh tactics and strategies.

Complete Missions & Earn Rewards
• Collect gold, currency, and rare upgrades by finishing challenging combat scenarios.
• Tackle wave-based survival, escort missions, and precision bombing runs.

The Ultimate Shooter-Simulation Hybrid
• Blends drone simulator realism with action-packed shooter intensity.
• Perfect for fans of tactical combat, military sims, and aerial warfare games.
• Download now and experience the next evolution of drone combat.

apps.title: Bible Trivia Journey
apps.summary:
How well do you really know the Bible?

Bible Trivia Journey turns Scripture into a daily habit. Thousands of questions across the Old and New Testaments, classic biblical art to identify, and a journey through the Holy Land that grows with you.

Why Play Bible Trivia Journey?

- Learn as you play - Questions span both Testaments, from Genesis to Revelation. The ones you miss are the ones that send you back to the Word.
- Picture rounds - Identify famous Bible scenes in classic engravings by Gustave Dore. No other Bible trivia game has them.
- 20 curated categories - Life of Jesus, Parables, Miracles, Women of the Bible, Kings and Prophets, Psalms and Proverbs, Revelation and more.
- Play anywhere - Full single-player offline play. No internet needed.
- Your language - Available in 48 languages.

How It Works

Each level gives you a set of trivia questions with four multiple-choice answers. Answer correctly to clear the level and move further along your journey. Miss one and you lose a heart; run out and you can wait for them to refill or use a hint to keep going. Levels mix in picture rounds, word-fill puzzles and bonus rounds, so it never settles into the same rhythm.

Features

- 5,000+ Bible questions across 20 categories
- Picture rounds featuring classic biblical art
- Word-fill puzzles and bonus round variety
- Daily challenges to build a streak
- Leagues - climb the ranks against players around the world
- Collect vistas as you journey through the Holy Land
- Single player, multiple-choice, play offline anytime

Whether you have been studying for years or are opening the Bible for the first time, Bible Trivia Journey meets you where you are.

Download Bible Trivia Journey and start your journey through Scripture today.

God bless.

apps.title: DRIFT RIDE 2
apps.summary:
DRIFT RIDE is a high-speed racing game focused on physics-based driving, precise control and pushing cars to the limit.

Drive through intense traffic, race against rivals, drift through corners, escape police chases and push your car to the limit across a large network of roads. From fast highways and city routes to technical mountain roads, every road is designed to create a different driving experience.

The game focuses on dynamic driving, responsive car control and physics-based handling. Each car has its own behavior, weight, grip and performance, giving every race, drift run and chase a different feel.

Customize and upgrade your cars with a deep tuning system. Improve performance, adjust key parameters and build your car for speed, grip, drift, control or aggressive street racing.

Game features:
• High-speed racing in dense traffic
• Physics-based car handling
• Physics-based drifting and free driving across different roads and conditions
• Police chases and intense action gameplay
• Rival racers with challenging driving styles
• Large connected road network
• Highways, city streets, mountain roads, desert routes, snowy roads and more
• Deep car tuning and performance upgrades
• Cars with different handling and characteristics
• Stylish visuals and dynamic camera movement
• Dynamic day-night cycle, changing weather and an immersive driving atmosphere

Every race in DRIFT RIDE is about control under pressure: choosing the right line, managing speed, taking risks and pushing your car to the edge.

apps.title: Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort
apps.summary:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

apps.title: Highway Heroes: Truck Manager
apps.summary:
🚚 Highway Heroes is the truck tycoon management game where strategy beats speed. Build a freight company from the ground up, plan smart routes across U.S. regions, and grow your idle tycoon empire through careful decisions — not quick reflexes. If you love a logistics game that rewards patience and planning, welcome home.

🗺️ Start with one garage and a single rig in this truck tycoon adventure. Line up hauling contracts, choose the best routes for profit and efficiency, and deliver on time to build your reputation. Every dollar earned is a decision made — reinvest in your fleet, expand your facilities, or unlock new regions. With idle tycoon earnings working for you around the clock, your company never stops growing.

🏗️ Build the infrastructure behind your logistics game empire. Add garages, service bays, and dispatch offices that directly improve turnaround time, driver reliability, and contract access. Every upgrade in this management game reshapes how your business operates — faster maintenance, smarter logistics, and bigger contracts within reach.

🎨 Customize your fleet down to the details in this truck tycoon. Choose authentic paint schemes, decals, lighting rigs, trailers, and performance parts. Clean isometric views and tidy menus make every choice easy to read and satisfying to make — even on smaller screens. The idle tycoon system lets your customized trucks earn while you plan your next move.

📦 Master the logistics game at the heart of Highway Heroes. Match the right loads to the right trucks, schedule around weather and distance, and keep fuel costs and repairs under control. Managing contracts in this truck tycoon feels like running a real business: orderly, fair, and deeply satisfying.

🛻 Collect iconic American haulers in this management game. From classic rigs to modern workhorses, each truck unlocks new routes and contract types. This is a logistics game where your collection has real strategic value — not just cosmetic appeal. Every truck you add strengthens your fleet with new cargo options and better efficiency across regions.

👀 See everything at a glance. Crisp isometric angles, clear icons, and legible text make complex decisions feel simple. Whether you're a veteran truck tycoon player or new to this kind of management game, Highway Heroes is designed for clarity over clutter. The idle tycoon mechanics keep your company running smoothly, so you can check in on your terms.

apps.title: The Walking Dead: Aftermath
apps.summary:
The dead walk. Society has fallen. Survival is all that remains.

Rick Grimes woke from a coma to find the world transformed. Cities abandoned. Families torn apart. The living forced to become something new just to survive. Step into the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead universe and begin your journey where it all started, in an action game shaped by the characters and stories fans know and love.

Now it’s your turn.

Begin your journey on the outskirts of Atlanta, where a fragile camp struggles to endure against the constant threat of the walkers. What starts as a desperate fight for survival quickly becomes something more. A test of leadership and who you are willing to become.

You are not alone.

Fight as iconic survivors from across the universe of AMC’s The Walking Dead, including Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, Glenn, and Maggie. Each survivor brings unique weapons, abilities, and combat styles into every run. Whether you prefer precision, power, or survival instincts, your choice of fighter will shape every encounter.

Every Survivor has their strengths.

🏕️ Build your camp and assign garrison survivors to strengthen defenses, generate resources, and support your long-term survival
⚔️ Take control of combat survivors with distinct abilities and playstyles in every run

Every decision matters. Every run is different.

🔥 Fight through relentless swarms and herds of walkers, including armored, burning, and other deadly walker variants
⚠️ Face dangerous human enemies, desperate to survive by any means necessary
📈 Grow stronger every run with new abilities, upgrades, and evolving strategies
🏕️ Build and defend your camp, turning a fragile shelter into a place worth fighting for
⚔️ Choose your approach, whether aggressive, tactical, or survival-focused
🌍 Explore locations inspired by the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead

Survival is not just about fighting the dead. It is about protecting the living.

The world has ended. The fight has just begun.

apps.title: Word Solitaire Go
apps.summary:
Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit.

apps.summary:
Welcome to Arrow Pro 3D, a relaxing and engaging 3D puzzle experience where observation, timing, and planning come together.
Rotate the cube, release arrows, and clear surfaces gradually. Careful observation and thoughtful decisions help create smooth clearing sequences and solve spatial challenges that gradually become more complex.
The controls are simple to understand, while puzzle layouts continue to encourage deeper thinking as progress continues.

- A fully rotatable 3D puzzle environment
Arrow Pro 3D takes place on an interactive three-dimensional cube. Unlike flat puzzle designs, every face contributes to the overall solution. At times, the answer may be located on the opposite side, requiring rotation and observation from different angles.
Players can rotate the cube freely, zoom in to inspect details, and study each surface before choosing the next move. This freedom allows exploration and supports thoughtful planning throughout each level.

- Release arrows and clear surfaces
The core mechanic focuses on releasing arrows in the correct order. Tap an arrow to activate it, and they will travel forward along its direction, removing other arrows encountered along the path.
Some arrows travel short distances, while others move across larger areas. Understanding how arrows interact allows multiple elements to be removed efficiently. Careful sequencing often creates satisfying chain reactions that clear large sections of the cube.

- Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles
Arrow Pro 3D contains a wide collection of handcrafted puzzles designed to maintain interest over time. Early challenges introduce fundamental behavior and basic movement patterns. As progress continues, layouts expand and require stronger observation and structured planning.
Players will encounter:
- Beginner-friendly compact cube layouts
- Medium difficulty spatial arrangements
- Large cube structures requiring careful reasoning
- Multi-stage solutions that reward planning and patience
Each layout presents a different arrangement that supports flexible thinking and encourages experimentation.

- Smooth and relaxing interactions
The overall experience focuses on steady pacing and visual clarity. Arrows glide across cube surfaces in a fluid motion. As elements disappear gradually, the cube becomes less crowded, creating a consistent visual rhythm.
A minimalist visual approach keeps attention on puzzle solving while maintaining readability during longer play sessions. Subtle animations provide visual feedback without distraction.

- Develop thinking skills naturally
Arrow Pro 3D offers a structured way to exercise reasoning skills while maintaining a calm environment.
Regular play supports:
- Spatial awareness
- Logical reasoning
- Planning ability
- Pattern recognition
- Problem-solving confidence
Players may spend time studying layouts carefully or proceed quickly through simpler puzzles. Each session supports observation and structured thinking.

- Designed for flexible play sessions
Whether there are only a few minutes available or a longer period of time, Arrow Pro 3D adapts comfortably to different schedules.Short puzzle layouts fit brief moments of play. Larger structures support longer sessions that encourage focused attention.
Suitable moments to play include:
- During short breaks
- While traveling
- Before rest
- During quiet moments
The structure supports gradual progression while maintaining a balanced level of challenge. Early puzzles provide clear learning opportunities, while later layouts require deeper reasoning and patience. Completing a puzzle often feels similar to solving a small mechanical structure.

apps.title: Spades Ace
apps.summary: Spades Ace is a timeless and widely loved trick-taking card game tailored for four players, who form two opposite sitting teams and compete cooperatively. Using a standard 52-card deck, the game follows a core fixed rule: spades serve as the permanent trump suit that beats all other suits in every round. Each round starts with blind bidding, where every player predicts their number of winning tricks, and the sum of teammates’ bids forms the compulsory team contract. During gameplay, participants play cards in clockwise order and must follow the lead suit if possible; players may play any card or trump with spades to seize the trick when they have no matching suit. Iconic mechanics such as high-reward Nil bids and cumulative bag penalties bring rich strategic layers, requiring players to flexibly switch between bold offense and steady defense. Teams gain points for successful contract completion and suffer point deductions for failed bids or excessive overtricks. Perfectly combining teamwork, logical judgment and tactical gameplay, Spades Ace is suitable for casual social entertainment and competitive matches, where the first team to hit 500 points wins the game.

apps.title: Sword x Staff
apps.summary:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world]
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going.
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in]
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind]
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring]
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same]
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

apps.title: Zoodoku
apps.summary:
Looking for a relaxing brain training game that keeps your mind engaged? Welcome to Zoodoku — a fresh logic puzzle inspired by the satisfying constraints of Sudoku and the clever deduction of Minesweeper.

Your adventure begins with adorable cats, dogs, cows, and many other charming animals. Every puzzle has one unique solution, and every move is powered by logic—not luck. Observe the clues, eliminate possibilities, and enjoy the rewarding "aha!" moment when everything clicks into place.

Easy Rules, Deep Strategy
The rules are simple to learn, but every puzzle offers a satisfying challenge.

• One Animal per Territory
Place exactly one animal in each colored region.

• Everyone Needs Personal Space
Animals cannot share the same row or column, and they can't even touch diagonally.

• Pure Logic, No Guessing
Use Sudoku-style constraints and Minesweeper-like deduction to discover the only correct solution. No math required—just careful observation and logical thinking.

Whether you're a Sudoku fan, a Minesweeper expert, or simply enjoy logic puzzle games, Zoodoku delivers a relaxing brain teaser that's easy to learn and rewarding to master.

More Than Just Cats
We know how much you love cats — but the joy doesn't stop there. Discover more adorable animals as you play. Unlock a growing collection of charming animal themes as you progress, each bringing fresh personality while preserving the same elegant puzzle gameplay.

Features
• Hundreds of handcrafted logic puzzles
• New Daily Puzzles to keep your brain sharp
• Relaxing brain training for all skill levels
• Beautiful animal themes to collect and enjoy
• Play offline anytime, anywhere
• Clean design with intuitive controls

Why You'll Love Zoodoku
Zoodoku combines the best parts of Sudoku, Minesweeper, and classic logic games into one relaxing puzzle adventure. Every completed level rewards careful thinking, logical deduction, and the satisfaction of solving a challenge without guessing.

Whether you're looking for brain training games, free brain games, logic puzzle games, or a fresh daily puzzle to enjoy, Zoodoku is the perfect way to exercise your mind.

Download Zoodoku today and discover a clever world of logic puzzles, adorable animals, and endless brain-teasing fun.

apps.title: Lordrush
apps.summary:
Lordrush is a medieval tower defense strategy game where you rebuild a ruined fortress and defend your realm from attacks.

Gather resources, raise defenses, upgrade towers, and recruit heroes as you prepare for each assault.

Set in a harsh medieval world of stone castles, armored heroes, war-torn battlefields, and rival lords, Lordrush blends fortress building, resource management, hero strategy, and tactical defense.


• Fight for Resources
Wood, stone, and iron are essential for expansion. Compete with exiles, rebels, and other forces for control of vital resources.

• Build Fortress Walls
Construct defensive walls to slow enemy advances and give your towers more time to strike.

• Upgrade Towers
Place and upgrade towers to expand your firepower, increase damage, and hold key defensive positions.

• Strengthen Your Fortress
As enemy attacks grow stronger, reinforce your walls, expand your towers, and turn your settlement into a powerful medieval stronghold.

• Defend Against Sieges
Enemies attack your fortress in waves. Adjust your defenses based on enemy routes and strength, and hold the line.

• Recruit Heroes
Recruit medieval heroes with different abilities. Deploy them to change the course of battle.

• Make Tactical Choices
Every building, upgrade, and hero deployment can affect the outcome. Plan carefully to survive the next siege.

• Manage Your People
Assign survivors as workers, hunters, or cooks to maintain resource production, food supplies, and daily fortress operations.

• Maintain Health and Order
Your people’s condition affects productivity. Keep food stocked, maintain stability, and help your fortress continue to grow.

• Issue Decrees
Set rules under pressure from scarce resources and outside threats. Maintain order and guide the growth of your stronghold.

• Join Alliances
Create or join alliances, share resources, coordinate defenses, and face powerful enemies together.

• Challenge Other Lords
Train heroes, build squads, and compete for points, rare rewards, and greater influence across the continent.

• Claim the Throne
Start from a single fortress, build your defenses, gather resources, expand your power, and become a lord who cannot be ignored.

apps.title: Zomline Survival
apps.summary:
The zombies are coming. Your base is the last line of defense.

Zomline Survival is a fresh mix of zombie strategy, tower defense, and 4X survival gameplay. Build your base, command legendary heroes, expand your territory, and fight back against endless zombie waves in a colorful cartoon apocalypse.

✅️ DEFEND AGAINST ZOMBIE WAVES
Get ready for fast-paced tower defense battles. Place your defenses and use smart strategy to stop incoming zombie hordes. As enemy waves grow stronger, every choice matters.

✅️ BUILD, GROW & EXPAND
Survival takes more than firepower. Gather resources, upgrade buildings, unlock new functions, and strengthen your base. With 4X strategy at its core, Zomline Survival challenges you to balance growth, defense, and expansion while adapting to an ever-changing battlefield.

✅️ RECRUIT LEGENDARY HEROES
Lead a cast of cartoon heroes inspired by famous figures and world civilizations. With distinctive skills, playful designs, and unexpected combat styles, each hero adds personality to your strategy and brings a fresh, unconventional twist to every battle.

✅️ A FUN TWIST ON THE ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE
Bright visuals, stylized characters, and satisfying progression give Zomline Survival a fresh identity. It combines the tension of zombie survival with the depth of a strategy game and the action of tower defense.

✅️ SURVIVE TOGETHER
Connect with players worldwide, exchange strategies, and work together to survive the zombie apocalypse. Build alliances, support your teammates, and face the chaos of the wasteland as a united force.

Download now and build your defense in the zombie apocalypse!
